description: Use when an agent must check a domain: does it resolve, who hosts its DNS and mail, is email authenticated, how old is it, when does it expire. Input: domain (e.g. example.com; URLs accepted). Output: JSON DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, CAA, SOA), mail provider, parsed SPF and DMARC, DNS provider, and RDAP registration (registrar, created, expires, age in days, status, DNSSEC). No contact data. Example: ?domain=google.com Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

domain.description: Public domain or hostname (punycode for IDNs, e.g. xn--...); a URL is reduced to its hostname. Internal/reserved names → 400 (not charged)

name: domain_lookup
title: Domain lookup: DNS records, mail provider, SPF/DMARC, RDAP registrar, creation/expiry dates
